purpose: Teach: 柏崎/佐野/矢野/松永/白石/吉岡/小松/亀井

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、柏崎警察署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are conducting a joint investigation with Kashiwazaki Station.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact confirmation. Even pacing, professional register. Slight upward inflection at the end—not quite a question, more like checking agreement on procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、佐野刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: And Detective Sano's on-scene response is being evaluated positively.
lines.style: Factual, observational. Measured cadence. Acknowledging competence without fanfare. Brief pause before the evaluative clause, like noting something commendable in passing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人矢野氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're also taking statements from witness Yano, I understand.
lines.style: Clarifying, slightly deferential. Softer attack than the previous line. Gentle questioning tone—acknowledging this is delicate with a witness. Careful not to presume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者松永氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And of course you're being considerate with the victim Matsunaga's family.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with underlying respect. Slower pace on this line—it matters more. Gentle finality, like recognizing something human beyond the case.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者白石氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: You've also gathered witness Shiraishi's statement.
lines.style: Brisk, professional summary. Direct. Light emphasis on 'gathered'—treating it as accomplished. No hesitation, confident in the groundwork.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者吉岡の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And you've confirmed suspect Yoshioka's prior record.
lines.style: Even, factual delivery. Routine procedural confirmation. No inflection—just stating what's been done. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識小松主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: You're coordinating with Forensics Chief Komatsu on scene verification.
lines.style: Neutral, collaborative phrasing. Steady rhythm. Light emphasis on 'coordinating'—acknowledging teamwork across departments. Professional courtesy in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の亀井様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you'll be meeting with prosecutor Kamei for pre-trial conferences as well.
lines.style: Warm, slightly closer in tone than previous lines. A hint of rapport settling in. Slight knowing pause before 'as well'—acknowledging you've covered a lot. Conversational but still professional.
